title: Python Fundamentals
summary: Learn to think in steps and express them in Python: values, control flow, functions, objects and files.

modules.title: Introduction to programming and Python
modules.summary: What programming is, and how a Python program runs.

lessons.title: What is programming?
lessons.summary: Programs are exact instructions. Learn to turn a problem into steps before touching syntax.
objectives: Explain what a program is
Break a small problem into ordered steps
Trace an algorithm by hand

lessons.title: Your first Python program
lessons.summary: Write and read a few lines of Python, and see what common mistakes look like.
objectives: Use print to display text and numbers
Explain what a comment is
Recognise a SyntaxError and a NameError

modules.title: Variables and data types
modules.summary: Names, values and the basic kinds of data.

lessons.title: Variables and names
lessons.summary: A variable is a name attached to a value. Learn assignment, reassignment and the four basic types.
objectives: Create and reassign variables
Name the four basic types and check one with type()
Explain why adding a string to a number fails

modules.title: Operators and expressions

lessons.title: Arithmetic and expressions
lessons.summary: Use Python as a calculator: the arithmetic operators, order of evaluation and the surprises of integer and float maths.
objectives: Use the seven arithmetic operators
Predict the result of an expression using operator precedence
Split a number with // and %
Explain why 0.1 + 0.2 is not exactly 0.3

lessons.title: Comparisons and logic
lessons.summary: Ask yes-or-no questions with comparisons and combine the answers with and, or and not.
objectives: Tell = from ==
Combine conditions with and, or and not
Predict how and and or are ordered
Test a rule on both sides of each limit

modules.summary: Combine values with arithmetic, comparison and logical operators.

modules.title: Strings and string manipulation

lessons.title: Working with strings
lessons.summary: Read characters by index, cut text with slices, join strings, and see why strings cannot be changed in place.
objectives: Index and slice a string
Join, repeat and convert text
Explain why a string cannot be edited in place
Spot an off-by-one slice

lessons.title: String methods and f-strings
lessons.summary: Clean and transform text with string methods, and build messages with f-strings.
objectives: Use common string methods
Chain methods on a result
Build text with f-strings and number formats
Give an AI one real example of messy input and the output you want

modules.summary: Work with text: indexing, slicing, methods and formatting.

modules.title: Lists, tuples, sets and dictionaries

lessons.title: Lists
lessons.summary: Create, change, sort and copy lists, and avoid the traps of in-place changes and shared names.
objectives: Add, remove and change list items
Tell sorted() from sort()
Explain why two names can share one list
Slice a list

lessons.title: Tuples and sets
lessons.summary: Use tuples for fixed groups of values and sets for unique values, and choose between lists, tuples and sets.
objectives: Create and unpack a tuple
Remove duplicates with a set
Combine sets with |, & and -
Choose the right container for a job

lessons.title: Dictionaries
lessons.summary: Store and look up values by key, handle missing keys safely, and read nested data.
objectives: Add, update and remove keys
Use .get() for missing keys
Read nested dictionaries
Count things with a dictionary

modules.summary: Store several values together, and choose the right container.

lessons.title: Making decisions with if
lessons.summary: Run code only when a condition holds, with if, elif and else, and see why the order of checks matters.
objectives: Write if, elif and else chains with correct indentation
Explain why only the first true branch runs
Predict which values count as True or False
Test a chain on both sides of each boundary

modules.title: Loops and iteration

lessons.title: For loops
lessons.summary: Repeat code once per item or a set number of times with for and range, and build results with the accumulator pattern.
objectives: Loop over lists, strings and dictionaries
Use range with start, stop and step
Build a total or a list with an accumulator
Trace a loop by hand

lessons.title: While loops, break and continue
lessons.summary: Repeat until a condition changes, leave early with break, skip a pass with continue, and avoid infinite loops.
objectives: Write a while loop that is guaranteed to end
Use break to stop a search
Use continue to skip items
Say what makes a loop stop

modules.summary: Repeat work over sequences or until a condition changes.

lessons.title: Writing functions
lessons.summary: Define functions with parameters, defaults and return values, and learn the difference between return and print.
objectives: Define and call a function
Explain why a function gives back None
Use default and keyword arguments
Describe a function precisely enough for an AI to write it

lessons.title: Scope and small functions
lessons.summary: Understand local names, the shared-list trap, how to split work into small functions, and how to check them with assert.
objectives: Explain what a local variable is
Predict when a function changes a list it was given
Split work into one-job functions
Check a function with assert
